sources.title: Doreen Bogdan-Martin re-elected Secretary-General of ITU
sources.quote_checked: I am deeply honoured for the trust ITU Member States have placed in me to serve a second term | Together, we can make sure the digital future leaves no one behind.

sources.title: Opening remarks, UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance
sources.quote_checked: put humanity at the core of another transformative technology | ready to shape its trajectory together

sources.title: Building a safer, more equitable AI future
sources.quote_checked: The warnings around artificial intelligence are real, but at the same time, the opportunities are real. | It's time to move from principles to practice. | We have to keep people at the center.

sources.title: AI Governance Day — From Principles to Implementation
sources.quote_checked: Governance is a continuous process of listening, exchanging ideas, and implementing practical solutions. | The goal is to make AI governance the cornerstone of a better digital future for all.
